hook.text:
Most people start
hangboarding
too heavy.

plate.title:
Keep your feet
on the plate.
plate.body2:
It measures exactly how much
goes through your fingers.

target.title:
Pick your load.
Hang exactly that.

log.title: Every hang in kg.
log.sub:
Add load when you're ready,
not when it feels right.

outro.title:
Save this for your
next hangboard
session.
